label: Final fix wave: fresh uncapped median of three
method: Three sequential full uncapped runs, 20s after 3s warmup; gateway0-3, upstream4-5, load6-7. Existing validated release binary, no source changes or competing benchmark/review load. Each numeric leaf median/min/max. Held-stream isolation separately recorded. Coherent writer prefix and row accounting required.
